notes.title: Map Update 3: Better colors and improved shadows + what's to come
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GH9Njw4ab6M&ab_channel=MonarchsDawn

Good day brothers and sisters, 
you likely noticed that we did not have a lot of updates in the past months.
We started prepared to approach publishers.

[h2]Dont worry, we have more coming.[/h2]
[list]
[*] changeable hotkeys
[*] tower attack homing towards their target
[*] jungle monsters spawning
[*] performance updates
[/list]

That said one of you told me the map was looking shitty because the grass on the ground and the moos on the stone were different colors.
Push comes to shove and the map looks better than before.
No more super bright grass.
No more distorted shadows. 

[h2]How to use color in games[/h2]
There is actually its own discipline when it comes to colors and how to use them.
A character bright colors is easier to see and focus on a darker ground than on ground with the same brightness.
When you look at Dota or Leagues environment you will notice quickly that its darker then you abilities or your char. Thats why.

Have a look at the grey versions of the old and new, in the old the minions are hard to see while the stones are bright as a cristmas tree.

notes.title: Map update, thoughts on balance and whats to come in the future
notes.notes:
Good morning everybody,
It has been a while. Let me show you what we have done and what will come in the future.

Huge effort went into improving the map. Now it looks beautiful and also has parkour movement at its core. 
[previewyoutube=SWSaP8576q0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
Our thought behind the new map design is the following.
The jungle consists of two floors.
When you are on the top floor of the map, you have a big advantage in ganking the enemy lanes and better vision over the battlefield.
To balance this out, we decided to place the strong monsters in the lower layer while the easy monsters that give less resources are on the top floor.

The top lane has a lot of objects in it that can be used for parkour while the bot lane does not. It is gone be a very interesting to see how the metas in the lanes develop because of this.
Axe and other heavy weapons will likely prefer the less parkoury area because the slippery weapon users will have a harder time avoiding them.

[h1]Whats to come[/h1]
[h2]Monsters didnt spawn[/h2]
We have a bug right now that Monsters only spawn for the host player. We concentrated on making the lane fun so it went on the low priority box. This will be fixed soon.
After testing the new arena we of course have to balance it out. We will remodel small parts If needed.

[h2]Homing tower shots[/h2]
A great disadvantage of the boltthrower was always that the axe could pressure him early on. Even under tower which should be a safe zone for the team. The towers projectiles could be dodged easily and made it a pushover.

Now the tower shots will home in on the attack, garanteeing damage on them.

[h2]Lots of bug fixes[/h2]
There are ton of minor bugs that we will tackle in the future.

notes.title: Finally the second playtest is getting close. We got a lot new stuff for you.
notes.notes:
[h1]Greetings warriors[/h1]
With the next playtest on the horizon, I want to go through a long list of everything that we added since the first playtest. Get hyped!

[h3]Feedback[/h3]
Thank you very much for all the feedback. It showed us that we are on the right track, making a very fun game, but we also have to spend more time on polishing. Parkour was not useful and the map looked ugly.

[previewyoutube=87ZOycZW6tU;full][/previewyoutube]
We got all that down in a [b]new map[/b]. It has a lot of verticality to use your new parkour moves and  and looks amazing too.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768344/2ef1d83b11f6b3af579ebc849170193b8ba6d07b.gif[/img]
[h3]Be like Tarzan, Climb the vines[/h3]
Additionally to the new map we have another parkour move that lets you use it in new ways.
You can go from the lowered terrain in the mid-lane up to the jungle in seconds.

We have seen a lot of new strategies and tricks popping up since. Using the verticality and big space to pull off some impressive ambushes and strategical maneuvers. An assassin jumping from the highest point in the jungle to ambush the mid-laner is still the coolest action we have seen.
I wonder what strategies you can come up with.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768344/ba4b49eed3e877661ff43b6902d6609a60bddee9.gif[/img]
[h3]Home Teleport[/h3]
With a bigger map the distance back to base also increased. That's why we implemented the Home-Teleport.
After activation, it charges up and teleport you home. Just watch out that you are not attacked which will interrupt it. The charging will break and you will remain stunned for the rest of the charge duration.

[h3]Boots[/h3]
A big fun factor to the MOBA genre is choice. 
Depending on how you want to play and the state of the game, a different item will give you an edge. 

All boots give a little bit different aspect of improvement to your movement. 

Or just use wacky all boots, super high movement speed builds to troll your friends.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768344/c9546dd0a9fa0e4459bcbe97b3d85f061e2492d5.png[/img]

[h3]Kill streak rewards and shutdowns[/h3]
Of course, you want to be rewarded for playing well. After killing two enemies, each additional kill will grand you extra gold.
If you manage to end an enemies kill streak, you will get rewarded too.

[h3]Minions and Monsters power increases over time[/h3]
Minions and Monsters got very weak in the lategame. It was not unusual to kill the entire wave with one ability. The same goes for monsters.
To counteract this, we make the two's power increase a little bit over time.

[h3]Armor Up Here[/h3]
All players now start with armor. The melee weapons gain a little more than Boltthrower and Dragon Mirror. 
We hope to reduce the dominance of Boltthrowers we witnessed during the recent tests.

[h3]Improvement of weapons[/h3]
We noticed that abilities that rely on the player looks at someone were really hard to use. They did not have an impact on a fight and asked you to be very accurate. We tried out a few methods and found an easy to use way.

[h3]Better performance[/h3]
We also made a few changes that will keep your PC from exploding when playing on the new map.

Other
    • improved animations and VFX
    • improved sounds
    • melee characters received an increased hitbox for their basic attack.
    • Lots of BugFixes

notes.title: We finally found and fixed the bugs
notes.notes:
I'm still pretty pissed we could not get the game ready in time for the insider Playtest.

But, I have good news
We finally fixed the two game breaking bugs ... and the other bug we discovered shortly after. That was such a pain. Now everything is looking bright for the [b]Playtest #1 from the 17th to the 24th of may[/b].

Dread that something is gone break also has set in. You know, usual game dev stuff.

[b]Now let me go a little into detail about the Playtest #1[/b]
Like a house, we build MD on a solid foundation, in our case that of a MOBA. 
The typical MOBA stuff hast to work, like abilities, items and so on.

When that is done, we start extending it with parkour movement and much more.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768344/e6109a0550e6731a1cf08e8a5a4dfe1ebf71603c.png[/img]


[b]A further part we want to test is balance.[/b]
Very important are design rules for the weapons.

They make sure that a character isn't perfect at everything or can just mitigate his weaknesses.

What comes to mind is an assassin. 
Usually these are good at killing one enemy with high burst damage and then running away. Now imagine the same assassin, but he also deals a lot of area damage and gets a big shield when he deals damage. 
Doesn't sound fun to play against, does it?

We want the game to be fair.
The perfect outcome would be that even if you loose, you know it's because the enemy  played better.

For this to happen, all weapons need strength but also weaknesses.

That is where you can help us a lot.
Because Monarchs Dawn has a lot of 3D movement, we can basically forget about copy and pasting from other MOBAs. It just does not work. Which means we are gone tap in the dark and need to get some experience. Please be patient.

After the playtest well make a huge round of gathering all your feedback.

That's all for today.
See you in the playtest.

notes.title: We have big plans in the future. Here is a Playtest overview and future content
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40768344/a25619387984cc59d5a14ecddf9a2315c45835f2.png[/img]

[h2]5v5 map[/h2]
More players 
bigger maps
more verticality
more fun

Actually, this map has existed longer than Tangled Timberline. The picture I had in mind is that of a   map split in half. 
On one side, a sprawling forest with a floor of blooming flowers and green grass. Birds are singing and the sun shines through a thick roof of trees. 
On the other side, the beautiful forest has been corrupted. The ground is of grayish moss, the trees are crackling and groaning and the animals are changed in strange ways.

[h2]Weapons[/h2]
Another big part of the updates is new weapons. 
Let me tell you, we have a lot coming.

There are many weapons in different stages of development.
Do you like spell casters? Throwing spells at the enemy for huge damage? That weapon will be the first of its archetype.

Another weapon that I am especially excited about lets you launch yourself through the air. Pouncing on the enemy. It will be the start of weapons giving you additional support in form of movement.

[h2]Parkour movement[/h2]
Getting up walls has always been a problem. It is a very important move, and was possible, but it felt bad and took a long time.
That is why we will add a new parkour move, the wall climb. Through it you can vertically climb up walls. Of course everybody can use it and you will be able to use it in combination with wall jumps.

[h2]General improvements[/h2]
The game has been made by two people and it shows under the hood. Even tho we poured our heart and soul into it, we had to cut corners or not use the state of the art tech. Game development can get very expensive very fast. What comes to mind is that Monarchs Dawns netcode is not Server-client. There were moments where we could have changed that, but I didn’t think you wanted to wait for the demo another year. Other parts contain mechanics that were just not important enough to concentrate on. Tower shots homing in on players, a smoother animation system, monsters and minions strength increasing over time, and items with interesting effects. There is no end to it.

notes.title: Demo Releases 17th May
notes.notes:
[h2]Greetings, Warrier. You have waited long enough. Take your weapon and get to the battlefield. [/h2] 

On [b]May the 17th[/b] the Monarchs Dawn Demo will be released. It will be free and available to everybody. 

Most of all, the demo is for you to have fun. 
Try it out, play with your friends, and get a good feeling how Monarchs Dawn plays. We will be greatly thankful for your feedback and what you want to see in the future.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216629/da57fec163cee3daa11054d7773d7f39d29dbce7.png[/img] 
The map has a lot of verticality that you can use with the parkour movement. Up to six players can play on the arena at a time, with 2v2 or 1v1 also being doable.

 [h3]Weapons[/h3] 
[b]Battleaxe[/b]: A tank that can deal enormous amounts of damage while still being tanky enough to take punches. 

[b]Boltthrower[/b]: A marksman weapon with high scaling single target damage output and a devastating AOE ultimate. 

[b]Dusack[/b]: A very mobile assassin that excels at flanking the enemy and picking out the enemy damage dealers with high single-target damage. 

[b]Leaf Queen[/b]: Mage weapon that is all about stacking poison counters on enemy heroes that deal continues damage. 

[b]Dragon Mirror[/b]: A support weapon with high single-target healing power. Healing others will heal yourself too. 

[h3]Items[/h3] 
We are not quite sure how we want to design the items. For now, we give you a mix of everything. It's up to you, what you buy and how you want to play. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43216629/d40d86d7648ed11cf31269d85ac63b52b6b2347a.png[/img] [h3]Monsters[/h3] 
Between the roads lies an area full of dangerous monsters. Slay them, and you will be rewarded. 

[h3]Matchmaking[/h3] 
For those who bring their friends along, we have custom matches. The creator decides who to let in and who plays on what team. Random matchmaking with other players 

[h3]The road ahead[/h3] The demo will be updated with content and bug fixes. It will be available until the main game is released. 

[h3]Playtest 17th of April[/h3] Now that you have read through all this, I would like to tell you about another special event. A month earlier, a few people will get access to the Playtest. They will be chosen randomly, so wishlist and request access if you would like to join us. The reason is mostly bug fixes and balancing, so everything is prepared for the demo.

notes.title: Close Alpha Update
notes.notes:
I can't tell you how glad I am. We have worked so hard for the last four years to get Monarchs Dawn to where you can enjoy it.
The time has come.
It's fun, it's amazing, it's a Moba like non before.
Now, grab a drink and let me tell you about the changes we have made.


[h3]New Arena[/h3]
The map has been completely reworked. Some of you might remember the dusty yellow beginnings of Monarchs Dawn. Now we settled in greener pastures in the middle of a big forest.


[h3]Weapon increases in power[/h3]
You like leveling up? Now weapon gains in power as you level up. Your attacks hit harder and your abilities gain too. At level 18 you will be an unstoppable force of nature.


[h3]Minions, Towers, Monsters[/h3]
We spent quite a big amount of time working on all of them. We hope that you will enjoy mowing them down. You can even see Monsters in the jungle. 


[h3]Item Shop[/h3]
Additionally, to your power gain with levels, you can now buy items in the shop. There is a huge verity to pick from. From raw damage boosts to armor that makes you hard to kill, it's all up for grabs. 


[h3]From here on out[/h3]
In the near future we will complete the missing systems like jungle monsters. From there on, we can focus specially on new weapons and balancing.

We work on a weapon for every class. With the initial cast you will have fun, no matter if you want to play an offensive tank, storming the enemy lines, a marksman gunning said tank down, the support healing the marksman or the assassin that is gone to kill them both.


Monarchs Dawn is a community driven project.
Many of you pre-alpha testers have given us immense help. I want to thank you for that and encourage others to tell us what they would like to see.



If you would like to participate in the closed alpha, message me at Jason@MonarchsDawn.com

-Jason
